task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
A laparoscopic view shows a surgical instrument with a dark grey shaft and metallic jaws entering from the upper right to manipulate a dark, reddish-brown, lobulated tissue mass in the center of the frame. The surrounding environment consists of glistening, wet, pinkish-red tissue and a translucent, bluish-white membrane or peritoneal layer visible in the upper left. The instrument's jaws repeatedly open and close, grasping and pulling at the central tissue, which appears to be a section of bowel or a similar organ. The camera angle shifts slightly, providing different perspectives of the manipulation, with the instrument moving from the right side towards the center and then retracting. The lighting is bright and direct, highlighting the wet, reflective surfaces of the internal anatomy. A small, circular icon with a lightbulb symbol is visible in the top right corner, and the text "NOVADQ" is in the bottom right.
